approved_at_semantics: Current artifact-establishment time under explicit operator approval; not DB creation, Collector execution, or historical approval time.
schema_sha256_method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 Python json.dumps(sorted(SELECT type,name,tbl_name,sql FROM sqlite_master), separators=(',', ':')), ensure_ascii=True.
logical_digest_method: For each table, select the listed formal schema columns ordered by the listed canonical key. Encode each row as UTF-8 json.dumps(list(row), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')); hash the concatenation of each row's 8-byte unsigned big-endian encoded length followed by its encoded bytes with SHA-256. Values and filesystem metadata are not stored in this artifact; these digests are continuity evidence, not authentication.
git_head_semantics: Source HEAD at approval verification, before committing this evidence artifact; not proof of DB identity.
historical_gap_reason: The complete row-level identity chain from Operator-Approved DB Baseline v0.1 through the 2026-08-28 comparison state to this DB is not independently proven. DELETE_STATUS_UNVERIFIED remains for comparisons originating at v0.1.
approval_scope: Continued use of the current production DB from this baseline onward.
Use the recorded current SHA, counts, schema and logical digests as Operator-Approved DB Baseline v0.2.
Evaluate future Collector and Backup differences from this baseline.
Use this baseline for safety review before Queue Persistence and Checkpoint work.
approval_exclusions: Complete row-level provenance from baseline v0.1 or proof of historical delete absence.
Absolute absence of historical manual writes.
Scheduler trigger provenance, global credential completeness, origin authentication or exactly-once semantics.
evidence_note: Explicit operator decision to trust the current DB prospectively, not retroactive verification. The 2026-08-29 Collector delta was consistent within the available comparison evidence, while the earlier chain limitation remains. Production DB was opened read-only; no DB copy, repair, restore, Collector or Backup execution is authorized by this artifact.
future_evidence_requirement: Preserve Collector pre-DB SHA, run result, post-DB SHA, logical table digests, Backup source SHA and Backup destination SHA in a separate future implementation.
